title: Narrow types based on collection containment

target.summary: Passing `[left_index, right_index]` as `expr_indices` to `narrow_type_by_equality` uses absolute operand indices rather than relative indices into the two-element `operands` slice. In chained comparisons (such as `x == y in z`), `left_index` or `right_index` can be greater than 1, triggering an `IndexError` crash.
notes: faulty argument passing absolute operand indices instead of relative indices [0, 1]
